links.outcome: LLM accuracy by query language (English vs Chinese)
links.effect: All models achieved significantly higher accuracy in Chinese versus English responses (all p < 0.05).
links.quote: All models achieved significantly higher accuracy in Chinese versus English responses (all p < 0.05).

links.outcome: Readability of English LLM responses (Flesch reading ease)
links.effect: English responses had lower readability (mean Flesch reading ease score 32.7) compared to Chinese responses.
links.quote: English responses had lower readability (mean flesch reading ease score 32.7) compared to Chinese responses.

screen.reason: Evaluates several commercial LLMs on Chinese medicine clinical practice guidelines questions assessing accuracy, readability, and presence of safety disclaimers, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or intervention.
